records.reason: The abstract establishes a retest of the initial PDSQ validation, but does not identify its authors, title, or citation. The supplied row 658 is Zimmerman and Mattia (2001), titled as the self-report scale paper, but the abstract does not establish that this is the same initial validation work rather than a related scale-development report. Need the full paper's citation/reference for the initial validation and confirmation that row 658 represents it.
records.omission_quote: The present report is the second large-scale validation study of the PDSQ in psychiatric out-patients. Because some of the sizes of the diagnostic groups in the initial report were modest, it is important to determine whether the recommended cut-off scores to screen for psychiatric disorders remained the same in a replication study.
